title: Jude and the Undertow
author: Freya Dravenmoor
blurb: Mirabel Fairweather, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the demolition date arrives.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
